# Track LLM and embedding token usage in compile_runs

This migration adds new columns to the compile_runs table to record real LLM and embedding API token usage. This enables precise tracking of calls and token counts for both LLM and embedding operations during compiler runs, replacing rough estimations and improving the accuracy of cost attributions.
